# Nuj Studios

> Boutique, in-house digital agency in Singapore providing web development, content marketing, SEO and AI workflow automation for SMEs.

Nuj Studios is a small, accountable team, not an outsourced pipeline. One team owns a client's website, content, search visibility and internal automations as a single connected system, engaged month to month rather than locked into long contracts.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://nujstudios.com/services/web-development): Custom, fast, SEO-ready websites built on modern infrastructure.
- [Content Marketing](https://nujstudios.com/services/content-marketing): Blogs, social and email content produced through a repeatable editorial pipeline.
- [SEO Optimization](https://nujstudios.com/services/seo): Technical SEO, keyword strategy, on-page work and structured data for search engines and AI answer engines.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://nujstudios.com/services/ai-automation): Custom automations and AI agents wired into existing CRM, invoicing and scheduling tools.
